title: Agency Proposal Leakage: When Pipeline Dies After the Send
description: Agency revenue leakage from proposal ghosting, slow follow-up, scope creep, and no-show discovery calls — with recovery tactics.

faq.q: Why do agency proposals leak revenue?
faq.a: Proposals sent without timed follow-up, unclear next steps, or pricing that does not match the buyer's decision process.

faq.q: When should you follow up on a proposal?
faq.a: Within 24–48 hours of sending, then on a short cadence (day 3, 7, 14) with a specific ask — not 'just checking in.'

blocks.text: Agency proposal leakage is revenue you already earned in effort — discovery done, proposal crafted — but never closed because the post-send process failed.

items: Proposal sent Friday, no touch until next week
No deposit or calendar hold before scoping work
Invoices net-30 while payroll is weekly
